verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described Smithery handling hosted MCP connections, including OAuth, token refresh and aggregated tools. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect and Toolbox stopped working on 2026-10-31, and that Smithery remains only a public, non-proxied registry. No hosted remote server URL is currently offered for clients to point at, so the capability is no longer delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure
